quotes.text: You are capable of amazing things. Take it one step at a time.
quotes.author: MoodLift

quotes.text: Progress, not perfection. Every small step counts.
quotes.author: MoodLift

quotes.text: Your mental health is a priority. Take care of yourself.
quotes.author: MoodLift

quotes.text: It's okay to take breaks. Rest is productive too.
quotes.author: MoodLift

quotes.text: You've survived 100% of your bad days. You've got this!
quotes.author: MoodLift

quotes.text: Small progress is still progress. Keep going!
quotes.author: MoodLift

quotes.text: Focus on what you can control. Let go of what you can't.
quotes.author: MoodLift

quotes.text: Your feelings are valid. Take time to process them.
quotes.author: MoodLift

tips.text: Take 3 deep breaths when feeling overwhelmed
Stay hydrated - it helps with focus and mood
Break large tasks into smaller, manageable chunks
Take regular breaks during study sessions
